clips.title: The story
paras: High Executor Hadrec is the military commander of the Forsaken garrison stationed at the Sepulcher in Silverpine Forest. From this central crypt, he oversees defense against regional threats including the gnolls of the Rot Hide clan and investigates the disappearance of scouts across the zone. He serves as the primary officer directing Horde operations throughout Silverpine.

Stationed within the gloom of the Sepulcher, High Executor Hadrec directs Forsaken military operations across Silverpine Forest. While Tirisfal Glades is firmly secured by the Dark Lady's forces, Silverpine remains fraught with peril, bordered by hostile Dalaran mages, feral worgen, and encroaching gnolls. Hadrec bears the grim responsibility of consolidating Forsaken territory and stamping out anything that challenges Undercity authority south of the capital.
